Tara (Marketing): Quick check 1 for the LaunchBox newsletter: final segment rules + resend plan. Draft at https://docs.redwood.ai/marketing/launchbox. Please confirm splits.

Omar (Growth): Proposed splits: 50% active trials (14d), 30% dormant trials (15-90d), 15% product users, 5% partners. Exclude enterprise rollout and active SDR-owned accounts.

Lena (Content): I tightened subject lines and added two preheaders. Subjects: "LaunchBox: faster inference at scale" and "Ship LLM features with lower latency". Recommend 2x2 test (subjects x preheaders).

Jake (Deliverability): ESP notes: set burst cap 100k/hr. Seed send 1k tomorrow 09:00 PT. If bounce >2% in first 30m pause and reroute to 72h drip. Ill export suppression lists tonight.

Tara (Marketing): Good. Add 5% control holdback for lift measurement. UTMs: utm_campaign=launchbox_newsletter&utm_medium=email&utm_source=newsletter.

Omar (Growth): Conversion = demo_signup within 7 days. Ill configure A/B allocation and winner routing (80% winner).

Lena (Content): Ill finalize hero stat once Tara confirms approved wording. Will keep body to 3 bullets + docs/demo CTAs.

campaign-bot: Campaign workspace updated: "launchbox_newsletter". Reminder: review meeting tomorrow 10:00 AM PT.

Tara (Marketing): Action items: Lena finalize copy (EOD), Jake export suppression + run seed (tomorrow AM), Omar set up tests + UTMs (tomorrow AM). Ping me for blockers. :rocket:
